title: Events
notes: Every climb now has two moments that belong to its sky, at floors that differ every run: the forge breathes and the crane swings on the Foundry; the swell and sea mist on Tidewater; smoke and the ground giving in the City; rockfall and dust in the Canyon; a rogue gust, wind shear and a kite on the Ridge; hoarfrost, whiteout and avalanche on the Glacier; lightning and nightfall on the Eclipse. Everywhere: lanterns to catch, and the Dark sleeping.
The Dark quickens without words now: its edge flares and it throws ink, and the floors-below count pulses.
